stance: Policy stance leans hawkish on euro-area inflation. September HICP yoy rose to 3.75% from 3.23%, above the 3.6% flash expectation, driven by energy (18.8% yoy) while core held at 2.5%. An energy-led overshoot limits ECB easing room but argues for a hold rather than hikes unless core firms. No Fed or BoE data logged yet. A core reading above 2.7% or a hawkish ECB statement would harden the view.
